title: CausaLM: Causal Model Explanation Through Counterfactual Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual substitution of gendered names and pronouns in template-based sentences (using the Enriched Equity Evaluation Corpus) to estimate the causal effect (Average Treatment Effect) of gender on mood state classification, alongside testing adversarial training to debias language representations.

Counterfactual substitution of race-associated names (e.g., African-American vs. European names) in template-based sentences to estimate the causal effect of race on mood state classification, alongside testing adversarial training to create race-invariant representations.
